decision_basis: declared after V2 scores and V3 feature distributions, before any V3 model score
primary_metric: mean two-class balanced accuracy with equal weight per validation participant
secondary_metrics: confusion counts by participant and class
single_class_policy: as V2: retain windows and predictions; two-class metrics are null and excluded from their summaries
selection: pooled inner out-of-fold equal-participant primary metric; first configuration wins exact ties

feature_selection.method: SelectKBest(mutual_info_classif) inside each training pipeline, tuned jointly with the model grid
feature_selection.position: after StandardScaler for kNN/SVM; first step for the tree. Mutual information is scale-invariant, so the order does not change the chosen features
feature_selection.reporting: selected features per outer fold; descriptive permutation importance on outer validation windows

fixed.tree_and_svm: class_weight balanced; kNN Euclidean with StandardScaler inside the pipeline, as V2
fixed.adaboost: SAMME, 200 rounds, class-balanced initial window weights, unweighted base DecisionTreeClassifier; all features (amended, see amendments)
fixed.bagged_knn: 50 members; bootstrap rows; each member draws max_features without replacement; StandardScaler + Euclidean uniform kNN inside every member
fixed.permutation_importance: 10 repeats, pooled balanced accuracy, outer validation windows, seed 42

amendments: 2026-11-02, before any ensemble score: the declared base-tree class_weight=balanced crashed AdaBoost on its first inner fit ('worse than random'), because the tree optimises balanced weights while AdaBoost scores it under uniform weights. Balance moved to AdaBoost's initial window weights; grid, rounds and all other choices unchanged.
search_budget: 18 settings (6 x 3 k) for each basic family and 6 for each ensemble, per feature group; 3 inner x 3 outer folds; no adaptive expansion

justification.selection_method: mutual information is a model-agnostic filter that captures non-linear dependence, is cheap, and is fitted on training people only; k = all keeps no-selection as an option
justification.selection_scope: the ensembles do not get the filter: boosted trees choose features at every split, and bagging already samples feature subsets
justification.boosting: AdaBoost reduces the bias of weak, shallow trees by reweighting windows the previous trees got wrong; depth and learning rate control how weak each tree is and how fast weights change
justification.bagging: bagging reduces variance by averaging members fitted on resampled windows; kNN barely changes under row bootstrap alone, so feature subsampling (random subspaces) is what decorrelates the members
justification.different_bases: the assignment asks for different algorithms in boosting and bagging: trees for boosting, kNN for bagging
justification.same_folds: all variants reuse the V2 outer folds and identical inner partitions, so results are paired by person
